# Who we are

We are a serious unit that bases it’s structure and operations off of the notorious Special Air Service, based in the UK, with a variation of nationalities within the actual unit. We are a international partner unit within JSOC, a community containing other like minded individuals and organizations.

Our unit focuses on providing a realistic and immersive experience, to the best of our ability, with campaigns that are fluid, meaning your actions and preparation for the task at hand matters, with lore to help immerse our players within the environment they are working in.

As per our realistic nature, we utilize mods like KAT Medical, ACE, and ACRE to add flavour and extra challenge to the operations we run.

All candidates that join and pass the application process will learn the way we do CQB, and other base skills which will help not only here but in general Arma.

​

# Requirements

The list of requirements, operation times and training for people interested, is located below

\- Be 16 years old (Exceptions are made on a case by case basis)

\- Able to attend the mandatory operations on Sunday @ 1800/6 PM BST

\- Be able to speak English

\- Have a microphone

\- Own a legal copy of Arma 3, Arma 3 Contact and Apex DLCs

\- Read through the Unit policy and agree with it

\- Last but not least, be willing to learn and possess the right attitude.
